scope: Single existing exposed trial. Recover public record/report chronology and primary-source identity; no cohort expansion, outcome labels or fitting.
projection_rules: Read only selected statusModule scalar date/type fields from frozen bytes; no resultsSection values. Missing remains null. Submission, QC, public posting, document upload and clinical analysis/decision remain separate.

history_open.purpose: Official public version-history interface; dynamic shell/access failure is not a usable historical version. No internal/historical API endpoint is assumed stable.

source_selection: After exact frozen searches, choose at most five additional returned primary-source items or their explicit primary links, plus the precommitted history page. Rank exact trial reports and official registry/NLM versions before related reviews. One source open counts even when unavailable. No query rewrite or unbounded citation expansion.
original_selection: Optional up to three original GETs only for source URLs actually returned/linked and eligible primary registry/NLM/publisher/institution sources. Freeze exact URL and host before dispatch; preserve headers, bytes, hashes, failures and no retries. Third-party mirrors/reviews remain leads only, not primary efficacy proof.
source_identity_checks: Exact NCT or explicit authoritative trial-identifier bridge
Distinguish case series, other TYK2 molecules/doses, prior trials and secondary reviews
Record article/version/abstract/full-text access, DOI/PMID, and original locators
chronology_checks: Report publication online-first versus issue/abstract date and retrieval
Explicit analysis/data-cut/unblinding/decision dates separately from completion and public disclosure
Source version public by2026-04-01 versus later audit-only material
Internal dates or current upload fields cannot independently establish historical PDF bytes or prospective authenticity
review: Two current source reviewers independently review the same retained source pack before seeing each other ratings; technical peer verifies query arguments/returns/identities/pins/caps. Preserve disagreements and missingness. Earlier trial/protocol exposure disclosed; no independent scientific truth claim.
future_or_partial_dates: Retain source-reported date semantics/precision; explicitly future publication dates are held. Year/month dates do not silently become exact days. A search crawl date is not first public disclosure.
unavailable: Retain missing primary reports, blocked access, unreadable history, conflicting scope and absent analysis chronology explicitly. Not recovered within bounds is never global absence or an efficacy negative.
outputs: Registry chronology projection; exact query/return receipts; bounded primary-source capture; independent reviews and technical acceptance; reconciled chronology with explicit unknowns; docs/memory/backup.
